concerns.text: FR-001's fourth validation — 'a pilot human manipulation check where ≥80% of a separate coder panel confirms the moral narrative is preserved' (also in SC-001) — has NO covering task. T003 implements only CLIP/RMS/texture/SSIM checks. No task recruits a coder panel or collects the ≥80% agreement rating, so FR-001/SC-001 cannot be fully satisfied.

T002 consumes '≥3 real annotator rating files from data/raw/human_coding/' but no task produces or sources those annotator files. FR-008's mandatory human coding step (≥3 independent annotators rating each scenario) has no task covering the annotation acquisition itself — the pipeline cannot run end-to-end as tasked.

FR-002/FR-003 require collecting blame ratings from real survey participants; T004 only builds the randomization/logging engine. No task covers participant recruitment or actual real data collection, so the dependent variable (blame ratings) has no acquisition path in the task list.

SC-003 requires the family-wise error rate to be MEASURED against the nominal alpha level to verify the correction was correctly applied. T006 only applies Bonferroni/Tukey corrections; no task produces a measurement/verification of the achieved error rate (e.g., simulation-based calibration).

plan.md lists 'bert-moral-intent' as a primary dependency and Constitution Check VI relies on the Moral Intent Preservation score (≥0.90), but no task builds, loads, or validates this model; T003 writes moral_intent_preservation_score with no defined computation task.

T006 writes results to data/results/results.json while data-model.md's Data Flow step 8 specifies data/processed/results.json. The canonical results location is inconsistent across plan artifacts; tasks should match the data model or the discrepancy should be resolved.
FR-006 requires effect sizes 'calculated using Type III Sums of Squares or equivalent'; T006 specifies odds ratios and CIs but no task states the Type III SS or equivalent computation.
plan.md and the constitution require a pinned code/requirements.txt, but no task creates or verifies it (T009 runs pytest but never establishes the dependency pinning artifact).
